touches.text: Owns the Claude Code hooks: mail check, the turn-shape and ask scans, the gates on record writes and deletes. Anything that adapts CC specifically to Cairn goes in the CC device, and every one of CC's scripts lives here.

artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). WHY: errors are permanent in records of truth (Law 7), and the journal is what shows a record moved by hand. USERS: everyone who writes a record.

The ticket IS its own manager. It carries its workflow and status, and asks each gate whether it can transit. If refused, it gets itself back to design for fixing. If no handler is available to ask, it throws a trouble and waits until we decide. Design is CC and Akien until the outline is implemented; a design agent comes after that. Until then a refused ticket waits in the trouble lane, which both read when a session opens, and nothing posts to a design verb that no machine answers.
Commit often. WHY: so we never wind up with stray files or incomplete work.
Test runs are transient (30 days, 4.3.2); seals are records of truth (git).
